contextual_sense_rationale.assist.help.v: The speaker requests help with two named routine activities; assist me selects the existing helping-a-person sense. The formal register remains intentional.
contextual_sense_rationale.collect.gather.v: One form from each of three teams produces a set from multiple sources. No preassembled reception bundle is being fetched.
contextual_sense_rationale.return.send-back.v: Borrowed explicitly modifies key, and the context supplies giving it back to reception. This matches the existing borrowed-item sense without widening to purchased-goods returns.
